brief: Second Eyes A2.3c implementation brief, 6 October 2026

design.name: crossed_cyclic
design.rule: code of object O[i] = C[(i + a) mod n]; object at choices-list position j = O[(j + p) mod n]; choices[j] = [C[(j + p + a) mod n], O[(j + p) mod n]]; [K, ASK] last; all positions zero-based
design.canonical_order: base request index, then a, then p, all ascending

schedule.rule: the identity cells first, in base request order; then every other cell by SHA-256 of UTF-8(salt + variant ID), ascending, ties by variant ID

canary.rule: |production - independent| <= atol + rtol * |independent| for every offered logit, and the same selected code and object

repeat_control.rule: |new - old| <= atol + rtol * |old| for every offered logit, with the same chosen code and decoded object or ASK
